findings.highlight: Almost the instant I realize I can't just use a Command Spell so casually
findings.governingReading: Immediately before impact, he characterizes the decision not to spend the Command Spell thoughtlessly as calm reasoning.
findings.explanation: Shirou calling his fatal hesitation ‘calm’ thought disappears.

findings.highlight: I managed to avoid falling on my head
findings.evidenceJa: 受身を取って頭からぶつかるのは避けた
findings.governingReading: He takes a defensive falling technique and thereby avoids a head-first impact, although catastrophic fractures remain possible.
findings.explanation: Shirou actively taking a breakfall is reduced to managing not to land on his head.

findings.highlight: My back seems fine; it looks like I survived the impact of the fall
findings.evidenceJa: 背中はまったくの無傷で、俺の体は落下の衝撃に耐え切ったはず
findings.governingReading: The narration establishes the anomalous absence of fall damage before contrasting it with blood from the chest.
findings.explanation: A completely unharmed back and a body understood to have withstood the impact become a back that ‘seems fine’ and a body that merely ‘looks like’ it survived.

findings.highlight: several swords protrude from my chest, together forming the shape of a flower in full bloom
findings.evidenceJa: 剣の刃らしきものが、胸の中から外に向けて咲いている
findings.governingReading: The grotesque image is directional and organic: things resembling sword blades bloom from the chest's interior toward the outside.
findings.explanation: Blade-like things blooming outward from inside the chest become several whole swords arranged in the shape of a flower.

findings.highlight: I don't understand what happened to my chest.
findings.governingReading: The fragment names the chest as having a wind hole bored through it, reinforcing the visible bodily opening.
findings.explanation: The concrete image of a gaping hole in Shirou's chest becomes generic failure to understand what happened.

findings.highlight: The miracle that healed me from Berserker's attacks
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーの一撃さえ治癒してくれた奇跡
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls the specific miracle that healed even Berserker's one strike.
findings.explanation: The single blow from Berserker that the miracle healed becomes plural attacks.
